name: Chapter looks: colour, fog and tone per chapter
body: Chapter 1 neutral, Chapter 2 saturated, Chapter 3 desaturating, Chapter 4 only thorns, Chapter 5 dark and cold (`game-design-document.md`). A `ChapterLook` data type sets the clear colour, fog range and gem tint, chosen by a `chapter` property on the world file's spawn entity.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's request to start using the Crimson and Thorn mechanics.

Built in slice 2: `ChapterLooks:::Apply(chapter)` sets sky, fog and sun from the level spawn's `chapter` property; the streets wear chapter 1 and `streets-later` chapter 3. See docs/crimson-and-thorn-slice.md.
